name: GND
connection_or_rule: Shortest return with at least two nearby vias

name: TS
connection_or_rule: 10k pack NTC to battery negative; 10k fixed fallback DNP

name: CE
connection_or_rule: GPIO11 and 100k pulldown; high disables charging only

name: PGOOD
connection_or_rule: Open drain to GPIO13 with 10k pullup

name: CHG
connection_or_rule: Open drain to GPIO12 with 10k pullup

name: ILIM
connection_or_rule: 1.55k to DGND for optional adapter-current mode

name: ITERM
connection_or_rule: 2.94k to DGND gives about 30mA in USB500 mode

name: ISET
connection_or_rule: 2.94k to DGND gives about 303mA programmed charge

name: Thermal pad
connection_or_rule: 4-9 thermal vias; do not omit pin8 connection

name: GND/EP
connection_or_rule: All ground terminals and exposed pad

name: GPIO0
connection_or_rule: 10k pullup and boot button to DGND

name: FB
connection_or_rule: Tie to output for fixed 5V version

name: QOD
connection_or_rule: Tie directly to pin6 for internal 24R discharge

name: SW1
connection_or_rule: Unused switch node; no copper extension

name: VLL
connection_or_rule: 1uF plus 100nF to DGND; power before VDD

name: CLR
connection_or_rule: GPIO7 with 10k pullup; high all OFF

name: RX1
connection_or_rule: To SMA and optional 100R termination DNP
